declarations.description:
An "On this page" navigation for long documents. It lists the headings of the page (or of the element named by
`for`), nests them by level, and follows the reader: the section at the top of the scroll area is marked current
(`aria-current="true"`) and a sliding indicator moves to its link. Activating a link scrolls to the section, moves
focus to its heading and updates the URL fragment.

Headings are read from the page and re-read when it changes; a heading needs an `id` to be listed, its
`data-toc-label` replaces its text, and `data-toc-ignore` leaves it out. Pass `items` instead to list sections
yourself, which also renders on the server.

members.name: for
members.description: `id` of the element whose headings are listed. Without it the page's `<main>` is read, or the whole body.

members.name: selector
members.description: Which elements of that element are listed, in document order. The level of `h1`–`h6` is its number; any other element's is its `aria-level`, or 1.

members.name: items
members.description: The sections to list, in place of reading the headings. Each needs the `id` of an element on the page.

members.name: label
members.description: Title of the list and name of the navigation landmark. Defaults to the translatable "On this page".

members.name: offset
members.description:
Distance in pixels from the top of the scroll area where a section becomes current, and where a link scrolls its
section to. Set it to the height of a sticky header.

members.name: keepUrl
members.description: Leave the page URL alone when a link is activated, for an app that routes on the fragment.

members.name: observing
members.description: What the MutationObserver watches: the headings of `observedRoot`, or the document for a `for` not there yet.

members.name: activeId
members.description: `id` of the current section.

members.name: entries
members.description: The entries listed: `items` when set, otherwise the headings read from the page.

members.name: scrollToSection
members.description:
Moves to the section `id`, as activating its link does. `behavior` replaces the smooth scroll (`'instant'` jumps),
and `focus: false` leaves focus where it is.

members.name: handleClick
members.description: Handles a click on the link of `item`: a plain click moves to its section, a modified one is left to the browser.

members.name: navigateTo
members.description: Scrolls to the section `id`, focuses it and records it in the URL unless `keep-url`; `false` when it is not on the page.

members.name: spy
members.description: Marks current the last section whose top has passed the offset line.

members.name: lock
members.description: Holds the clicked section current while the page scrolls to it, so the sections passed on the way do not flash.

events.name: active-change
events.description: The current section changed, by scrolling or by activating a link. Does not bubble.

declarations.description:
The A to Z rail beside a long list, such as a contact list or a glossary. It lists the sections of the element named
by `for` (or of the page) by key, marks the key of the section being read, and jumps on a tap. Dragging along the rail
scrubs through the list: each key passed under the pointer jumps to its section at once, and a bubble beside the rail
shows the key. With `keys` set, the rail always shows that alphabet and dims the keys no section is filed under.

It is a `c2-table-of-contents` in another shape: `for`, `selector`, `items`, `offset`, `keep-url`, `activeId`,
`scrollToSection()` and the `active-change` event work the same. Each section is filed under the first character of
its label (a heading's text, or its `data-toc-label`), or under the `key` of an entry of `items`; nesting is ignored.
The rail is one Tab stop: the arrow keys, Home and End move between its keys, and Enter jumps.

members.name: keys
members.description:
The keys of the rail, in order: one character each (`ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ#`), or `;`-separated or a JSON
array for longer keys. A key no section is filed under is dimmed. A section is filed under the key equal to its own,
else one that differs only by accents or case, else `#` when the rail has it. Empty: the keys of the sections.

members.name: items
members.description: The sections to list, in place of reading the headings. Each needs the `id` of an element on the page, and may name its `key`.

members.name: label
members.description: Name of the navigation landmark. Defaults to the translatable "Index".

members.name: focusKey
members.description: The key that holds the Tab stop while the rail has focus: a key, not an index, so a change of keys keeps it.

type.text: { pointerId: number; id: string | null } | null

members.name: keyModel
members.description: The keys of the rail, rebuilt only when the sections, the keys or the language change.

members.name: scrubTo
members.description: Jumps to the section of the key at `clientY`, or of the nearest key that has one.
